priority: P1 — validar Dark Hole pelo handler real de componentes Discord 2v2, destruindo monstros de quatro assentos físicos nas duas equipes e preservando UID/propriedade física no Cemitério compartilhado.

card.name: Dark Hole
card.officialText: Destroy all monsters on the field.
card.firstTcgSet: Legend of Blue Eyes White Dragon (LOB-052)

scope: Discord 2v2 integration regression for an already certified card; no new admission or certification.
behaviors: Uses handleTagComponent → tagStore.actTag → tagDuel/duelEngine; does not call stepTagDuel directly for the action under test.
Starts with the active physical seat 1 and monsters physically supplied by seats 0, 1, 2 and 3 across the two shared team fields.
Dark Hole destroys all four monsters on both teams, not only the opposing team.
Each destroyed monster reaches its controller team's shared Graveyard with the original physical UID and card ID.
The resolving Dark Hole reaches its controller team's Graveyard.
The inactive partner cannot submit the team's action.
All 120 Main Deck UIDs/identities, all four Extra Decks and the other three private hands are conserved; only Dark Hole leaves the active player's hand.
Discord public/private payload builders pass validateDiscordPayload.
Persistent players and player_cards tables remain unchanged.
limitations: Discord is exercised offline through the production component handler, store, duel engine and payload builders; no live guild/token is used.
This is an integration regression for an already certified card, not a new card certification.
The test uses temporary SQLite and borrowed NPC decks; persistent player inventory is not modified.
